home.answer1: Our website is dedicated to providing Christian resources that inspire, equip, and encourage ministries around the world. We aim to create a collaborative space where people can share and access materials for worship, education, and outreach.
home.answer2: Yes, you can contribute your own materials to the library. By default, any materials you create will remain private. You have full control over whether you want to make them public and share them with others. If you choose to make them public, they will be accessible to the community for use.
home.answer3: First of all, it was created for those involved in youth and children's ministry, but it is open to materials for all ages and ministries.
